justification: The proposal only prepares and applies an already-authorized draft Requests.save after explicit C12 human choice/review. It does not submit_pr, create or approve a financial step, modify policy thresholds or assign a holder. However three preexisting tests contain contradictory negative oracles, requiring REG-01..03 before an owner composition and CI can be assessed.

findings.evidence: base 998f0afd rejects C12 estimate with financial-approval-command-unavailable, blocking prepareDomainCommands -> captureSource and HTTP preparation; previous B11 and B18 failures are historical, not rerun
findings.resolution: SRC-01+SRC-02+SRC-03 implement exact existing save-estimate draft policy, real host/actor/source/CAS/preview and versioned human review; no submit_pr or approve

findings.evidence: original line 18 asserts financial-approval-command-unavailable for changed estAmount without confirmed; new canonical rule explicitly requires confirmed:false and emits explicit-draft-command-required for legacy
findings.resolution: REG-01 updates old assertion and asserts approved draft intent vs true/absent confirmation, without bypassing PR stage or holder

findings.evidence: original lines 32-34 assert all canonical draft preparations are blocked; lines 63,83-84 demand deprecated reason for non-explicit legacy commands
findings.resolution: REG-02 asserts bounded prepared Requests.save, unchanged state/retries and real source, rejects forged or implicit confirmation, retains stale/other-principal denial

findings.evidence: original line 79 expects C12 to deny even the already canonical chosen draft amount; post SRC-01 intentionally accepts only an explicit draft save
findings.resolution: REG-03 asserts C12 command action save/confirmed:false/current version/evidence/conditioned preview; independent submit and approver checks retained

findings.evidence: old fixture obscures real HTTP body/C12 failure reason; a fixture-only success would not create a production capture
findings.resolution: FIX-01 and FIX-02 are diagnostic-only; production capture is SRC-01+SRC-02+SRC-03 plus existing real preferences and Atlas publishing implementation

findings.evidence: repair220 B9 found invalid acceptance of unknown cases projection; independent of financial decision and bundled in closure228
findings.resolution: SCHEMA-01+SCHEMA-02 preserve closed empty cases projection, reject foreign keys; do not use them as C12 proof

guardrails.authorized_draft: createProcurementApprovalLifecycle.review/prepare(save-estimate) checks principal, current source, stage draft/pr_rejected and creator/admin
guardrails.domain_authority: runtime/procurement.ts execute enforces canWrite, requester/creator/admin, version CAS and stage; submit_pr and approve remain different actions
guardrails.actual_approval: procurement-screen.ts approvalDecision plus pending holder and blockSelfApproval; not used by C12 draft save
guardrails.human_C12: decision-host.ts prepare-changes and decisions.apply separate human admissions and 5min review digest
guardrails.backend_cas: prepared.ts selected target version and physical source; prepared-apply.ts receipt-domain atomic transaction

evidence.C12: pinned plan contracts.json C12, C03, C09, C08; WP11.T03.INV.01; WP11.T04.DOD.02 and INV.01
evidence.regression: REG-01/02/03 exact original tests and complete postimages

policy_change_outside_product: None identified. If the owner proposes approval of pr_pending, bypasses self-approval, reassigns holder, changes thresholds or authorizes post-approval save, exclude that change and request the distinct genuine policy authority.
